items.question: What is a NIE number?
items.answer: The NIE (Número de Identificación de Extranjero) is a Spanish identification number for foreigners. It's required for anyone who wants to buy property, open a bank account, work, or invest in Spain.

items.question: Do I need to travel to Spain?
items.answer: No. Through our service, the entire process can be handled digitally from wherever you are. You grant power of attorney to our partner lawyers, who then represent you before the Spanish authorities.

items.question: How long does it take to get a NIE number?
items.answer: Typical processing time is 4-8 weeks, depending on the Spanish authorities' case processing time. We keep you updated on status throughout.

items.question: What's included in the 215 EUR price?
items.answer: Our service price covers: digital form completion, digital signing, document generation, coordination with a lawyer, and status updates. Lawyer, notary, and government fees in Spain are paid directly by you and are not included.

items.question: What documents do I need?
items.answer: You primarily need a valid passport. Depending on the purpose of the NIE number, additional documentation may be required, which we'll guide you through along the way.

items.question: Is my personal data secure?
items.answer: Yes. We fully comply with GDPR regulations. Your data is stored encrypted and shared only with the parties necessary (lawyer/notary) to process your application.

items.question: Can I track the status of my case?
items.answer: Yes. Through your personal dashboard you can check your case status at any time, download documents, and read updates from us.

items.question: What happens if my application is rejected?
items.answer: Rejections are rare, but if it happens, we help you find out the reason and submit a new application at no extra cost.
